html:
Greetings, Agents. 

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

The warriors of Asgard are ready to defend across time
against the Super Villains who have invaded to conquer the Ten Realms!
The theme of the July Update is the <War of the Realms>. 

 

Odin, the Avengers from 1,000,000 BC, has acquired Tier-4
and Angela, the assassin who has realized her true self, 

has acquired a new Uniform with the power to defend their world.

 

The guardians of Asgard will have to fight against 
the immortal sorceress Enchantress, who has acquired Tier-3 
and Malekith, the leader of the Dark Elves together with Ulik who will assist his attack.

 

We have prepared various improvements to support Agents who will join new battles
such as the Team Setting Position Filter feature improvements
and the addition of Story Mode reward counts on the Content Status Board as well! 

 

Please check the details below.

 


▣ Four New Uniforms

 

The great all-father, the dangerous sorceress, the powerful autocrat, 
and the warrior of Asgard have acquired new Uniforms.
Check out the abilities of Odin <Avengers 1,000,000 BC>, Enchantress <War of the Realms>,
Malekith <War of the Realms>, and Angela <Asgard’s Assassin>.
* New Uniform Skills are based on the following skill Level stats. (Tier-4 heroes: Lv. 10, Others: Lv. 6)      
* The four new uniforms will be on sale for 40% off during the <July Update Celebration Event>, 
and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and the Uniform Room after the event.

 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Odin Tier-4

 

Odin is now available for Tier-4 Advancement.
Check out the looks of the mighty god who will show the true powers of Odin’s Force!
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 


▣ Enchantress Tier-3

 

Enchantress is now available for Tier-3 Advancement.
Watch out for the powers of her attractive dark magic!

 

 

 

 

▣ Malekith & Ulik Potential Awakening & Transcend Potential

 

Through the July Update, Malekith and Ulik will acquire Potential Awakening & Transcendence!
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

 

▣ New Artifacts

 

New Exclusive Passive Skill Artifacts for Odin, Enchantress, 

Malekith, and Ulik will be added after the July Update.
* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 

 

▣ New Future Pass Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass will begin after the update.

 

[Future Pass Rewards]

- Please note that the Future Pass effects 
will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Legendary / Mythic Future Pass that has been unlocked 
will only be applied during the season the Pass was purchased,
and the Pass rewards will only be available during the same season. 
Please don’t forget to check the remaining event time.
- The Mythic Pass can be purchased after purchasing the Legendary Pass.
- Legendary and Mythic Future Passes will not be available for purchase 
when the season is about to end. Please check the sale schedule in the game.
          
​New Special Icons that will represent you have been added.
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Rewards, 
one as Otherworld Battle rewards, and one more from the upcoming Event!

 

[July Update New Special Icon]

          

 

 

▣ Uniform Collection

 

Check out the new Uniforms inspired by War of the Realms.
Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn a reward.

 

 

 

▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. The filter feature of the team setting screen
for World Boss, Shadowland, and Giant Boss Raid has been improved.
- Leader Filter: A feature that filters Leader heroes 
with a Leader Skill that can apply to the participating heroes has been added.
- Support Filter: A feature that filters Support heroes with a Passive Skill, Tier-2 Skill, 
or Uniform Effect that can apply to the participating heroes has been added.
- Dealer Filter: A feature that filters Dealer heroes that can receive all the 
Leader, Passive, Tier-2, and Uniform Effect of the participating heroes has been added.

 

 

2. The remaining reward counts for Story Normal / Ultimate difficulty  
can now be checked on the Content Status Board.

 

 

3. Support benefits for new Agents have been added.

 

- The support benefits will apply to Agents who have created their accounts 
after 7/25 (Tue) 15:00 (UTC+0), 7/25 (Tue) 8:00 (PDT).
- The support benefits will apply for 14 days after creating an account.
- The support benefits can be extended by purchasing the <New Agent Support Pack>.
* The <New Agent Support Pack> can be purchased 
when the remaining period of the support benefits is below three days.
- Please check the related benefits and products in-game.

 

4. The regular game mode Timeline Survival will be changed to an event with a set period.
- The event progress and rewards will be announced through a separate notice afterward.
* The map clear reward will be set through the Inbox for Agents who had participated
in Timeline Survival before the 7/25 Maintenance and were not able to receive the rewards.
* The rewards can be acquired from the Inbox only for seven days after the maintenance.

 

5. The number of Clear Tickets that are used for each round 

can now be checked when turning the Auto-Repeat feature on during battle.

 

6. The Convert / Dismantle button will be displayed according to the Enchant Level of the Sword.
- 6 Level: The Convert button will be displayed 
- 1-5 Level: The Dismantle button will be displayed

 

7. The purchase conditions and components 

of the <Daily Gift Chest> for novice Agents have been changed.
[Purchase Condition]
Before: S.H.E.I.L.D. Level 1 - 30
After: S.H.E.I.L.D. Level 1 - 50
- Please check the components and probability in-game.

 

8. Agents can now move to a different theme on the main screen
of Epic Quest and World Boss using the left and right arrows.

 

9. The size and location of the Tier-4 Skill Striker Hero UI have been changed
so that Agents can view the Custom Gear activation effect.

 


▣ Game Error Fixes

 

1. The Enchant animation stopping and being displayed abnormally when tapping 
the ‘Color Assist Mode’ button while enchanting X of Swords individually has been fixed.

 

2. The Cooldown Time of specific skills being reset when the phase changes 
in World Boss: Legend <Kang the Conqueror> practice mode has been fixed.
 

3. The Battle Point of other Agents for Season 1 being displayed as 4500 
at the previous rank of Otherworld Battle has been fixed.
 

4. The 5th Active Skill of Wolverine <X Deaths of Wolverine> 
being displayed abnormally at the skill preview pop-up screen has been fixed.

 

5. The Otherworld Battle debuff effects not being applied 
to heroes with revive skills after they have revived once has been fixed.

 

6. Some patterns of World Boss: Legend <Mephisto> with a Pierce effect 
being displayed in red have been fixed.

 

7. Dodge being applied to some patterns of World Boss: Legend <Mephisto> has been fixed.

 

8. Auto Play+ not being applied when VIP Level is 1 or below has been fixed.

 

9. Some patterns of World Boss: Legend <Infinity Ultron> 

dealing damage regardless of Pierce and Damage Immunity has been fixed.
 

10. The bonus effects of the Concentration ability not being applied 
when charging the gauge for Reforged C.T.P.s has been fixed.
- Penetration, Steel, Ambush, Defend, and Vitality effect:
The gauge will be charged more when being hit when the Concentration stat is higher.
- Beatdown, Type Amplification, and Strike effect: 
The gauge will be charged more when moving when the Concentration stat is higher.
- Blade and Enraged effect: 
The gauge will be charged more when using skills when the Concentration stat is higher.

 

We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.

 

Thank you.
